comment: Generated by tools/s2-hilbert/generate-scene-map.mjs. Do not edit.
Each scene is joined to an archive site by the wall clock in its export
header, and takes that site's position. Correct a position in
tools/s2-archive/map-marks.json and rebuild; the marker, the cell and the
public_html/scene-overrides.json holds what cannot be derived: a human
title, a written summary, and a position for a scene the archive does not
cover or whose map reading is known to be wrong. An override always wins,
so a survey is never overwritten by a reading off the paper map.

sites.title: SoMa 1
sites.summary: Eleven minutes of pedestrian-heavy traffic on Howard Street.
sites.position_note: Not surveyed. The recording is sensor-local, so the scene plays without a position; it cannot be placed on the map until one is measured.

sites.title: Union Street near Van Ness
sites.summary: 33 minutes of a static roadside recording.
sites.position_note: Read from the field map (Union Street near Van Ness), matched to this recording by the clock rather than by hand. Neighbourhood-level: the one scene with an independent check was about 450 m out. Replace with a survey.

sites.title: Broadway & Columbus
sites.summary: A North Beach junction, recorded from a static roadside sensor.
sites.position_note: Hand-entered to the junction, not surveyed. This recording is the same session as archive site s13, whose field mark was read about 600 m away as 'Broadway near Sansome'; the junction name is the better fix, so it overrides the mark. Replace with a measured position when one is taken.
